description: This file defines the OAuthService class responsible for managing OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, update, and check the status of a mobile OAuth client identified by a specific client ID.

classes.name: OAuthService
classes.description: Service class for managing OAuth clients, particularly focused on a mobile client with a special client ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the OAuthClientDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: updateMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables the mobile OAuth client based on the provided boolean parameter.

methods.name: getMobileClientStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the mobile OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: getMobileClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the mobile OAuth client, if it exists.
